name: vllm_moe_lora_align_block_size
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_moe_lora_align_block_size.py. MoE+LoRA block alignment: sorts and pads topk_ids by expert, computes LoRA metadata. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.moe_lora_align_block_size with 13 args (7 inputs: topk_ids, token_lora_mapping, num_experts, block_size, max_loras, max_num_tokens_padded, max_num_m_blocks; 5 output buffers: sorted_token_ids, experts_ids, num_tokens_post_pad, adapter_enabled, lora_ids; plus expert_map=None) and writes results into buffers. Source uses configs (num_tokens, topk, num_experts, block_size, max_loras) from parametrize; migrated workloads use representative configs. Output shapes are interdependent: max_num_tokens_padded = num_tokens*topk + num_experts*block_size, max_num_m_blocks = max_num_tokens_padded // block_size. Requires vLLM at eval time.
